title: InteractionDeclinedEvent
description: A person declined a held call of a run they act for, and the decision holds for their runs in the conversation (ADR-GRANT-01 D9, R38-AUTHZ): the same tool to the same destination (the ask's destination.key), or with the same arguments (its argsDigest) when it names no destination, is declined again with the same reason instead of being asked. Node writes it in the same commit as the call's interaction.resolved, only for the run's own actor's denial and only when the worker's interaction.explained named the call's key, and a copy (fromRunId) on every other open run of the conversation whose actor is the same person. Never written for another person's runs: each participant decides for their own. Folds ignore it.

toolId.description: The tool the person declined (the ask's toolId).

key.description: What the decline covers: the ask's destination.key, else its argsDigest.

by.description: Who declined: the run's actor. The decline covers only runs that act for this person.

reason.description: Why the person declined, as they wrote it (secrets redacted), told to every run the decline answers.

fromRunId.description: On a copy Node writes on another open run of the same person: the run whose ask the person declined.

data.reason: Not this project: we track it in the roadmap board
